items.title: Bitcoin tags $65K as S&P 500 rebounds from 2-week lows on US-Iran rhetoric
items.summary: Bitcoin returned to $65,000 for the first time in a week as fresh BTC price volatility accompanied US claims that the Strait of Hormuz was “open and operating.”

items.summary: The Tokyo-listed firm will seed gaming media company Super League—to be renamed Superplanet and trade as SUPA—with 2,100 BTC.

items.title: Bitcoin miners’ AI pivot pays off, but mining could revive with one twist
items.summary: Miners with AI and high-performance computing contracts have commanded higher valuations as declining bitcoin prices and hashprice squeeze pure-play operators.

items.title: Global bond yields surge as debt fears test bitcoin’s hedge narrative
items.summary: Long-term borrowing costs are reaching multi-decade highs as U.S. debt approaches $40 trillion and AI hyperscalers accelerate bond issuance.

items.title: Japan's Metaplanet launching U.S. bitcoin treasury company through $135 million nanocap deal
items.summary: The deal involves Metaplanet contributing 2,100 bitcoin and $2.5 million in cash, valuing the initial investment at $134.6 million.

items.title: Bitcoin Wallet Untouched for 15 Years Suddenly Springs to Life
items.summary: The address received 8.54 BTC in June 2011 when the coin traded around $14 and stayed silent for 15 years before moving roughly $538,000 in a single transaction.

items.title: Citi plans to launch bitcoin custody for institutional clients later this year
items.summary: The Wall Street bank plans to let clients hold bitcoin alongside traditional assets through its new Custody+ platform.
